name: RLWDQA
intro: RLWDQA 是 Qwen3-VL 技术报告表 11 与表 12 中仅以列标题出现的未定义评测项；报告未披露其全称、任务身份、构建流程或评分方式。
intro_en: RLWDQA is an undefined evaluation column that appears only in Tables 11 and 12 of the Qwen3-VL Technical Report; the report does not disclose its expansion, task identity, construction process, or scoring method.
drawio_review_note: reviewed_at=2026-07-18; status=source-reconstructed-awaiting-independent-signoff. Evidence scope: the supplied benchmark record has no standalone source, and the Qwen3-VL Technical Report does not cite or disclose a standalone RLWDQA paper, repository, dataset card, or official download. The only primary paper evidence available is the Qwen3-VL Technical Report, arXiv:2511.21631v2. The archived PDF SHA256 is ee075d08e67de1148d6437c6c1d481f7894183b8793905a2deb5f62664f49380; the archived LaTeX source TAR SHA256 is 4ce6bd67718d45ad150009892d0337f61f62e4fc3b0d442c76d2f4fd01f07b0d; the cross-checked Qwen3-VL repository revision is 96588727e44c78b25ba03ea03b8e12f7e64fd0da. A full-text search of the complete LaTeX source establishes that RLWDQA appears exactly twice and both occurrences are table headers; there is no bibliography entry, footnote, acronym expansion, dataset description, item example, appendix definition, or construction section for RLWDQA. The first occurrence is Table 11, the Qwen3-ViT ablation: Qwen3-ViT and SigLIP-2 are compared for downstream vision-language performance while paired with the same 1.7B Qwen3 language model after 1.5T-token training. The RLWDQA column reports 58.7 for SigLIP-2 and 66.1 for Qwen3-ViT. The report does not name the RLWDQA metric, describe its scoring unit, or expose an evaluator. The second occurrence is Table 12, the DeepStack ablation: an internal 15B-A2B LLM is pretrained on 200B tokens, evaluated directly on validation sets without post-training, and compared with and without DeepStack. The RLWDQA column reports 67.7 for the baseline and 68.1 for DeepStack. These values are model-ablation results, not evidence of how RLWDQA was collected or scored. Construction boundary: provenance, source documents or images, collection period, filtering, decontamination, annotation roles, label schema, quality assurance, exclusions, and adjudication are all undisclosed. Release boundary: the report gives no sample count, split sizes, schema, examples, license, hosting location, immutable revision, or access terms. Evaluation boundary: prompt, preprocessing, image handling, answer normalization, parser, metric definition, scorer implementation, aggregation, uncertainty treatment, and failure policy are undisclosed. Identity boundary: the Qwen3-VL report does not expand RLWDQA, identify its task, language, modality, or metric, and it must not be conflated with another similarly named real-world, document, or visual question-answering dataset. Taxonomy boundary: Table 11 supports only the broad Multimodal L1 placement because RLWDQA is explicitly a VLM benchmark column; L2, difficulty, task, language, modality, metric, and related-benchmark fields remain undisclosed or empty and are not inferred as document QA. The bilingual specs therefore present a result-only disclosure audit: solid edges connect only the two table contexts and values actually printed in the report, while all source, construction, release, evaluator, and non-reconstructibility statements are dashed boundaries. No generic document-QA or visual-QA construction pipeline was substituted. English labels were kept free of Chinese text; Chinese labels preserve the same limitations and numbers; node IDs, positions, styles, edge tuples, and dashed semantics are intentionally identical. This is source-stage evidence only. strict Draw.io/XML and runtime visual review are required next; formal assets and page fallbacks remain gated until independent reviewer approval. The existing drawio/svg/png/arch files were not regenerated or treated as publication evidence in this source-stage reconstruction.
